name: M&A Capital Partners Co Ltd
summary: Operating within Japan, M&A Capital Partners Co.,Ltd. functions as a mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage firm. The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, including advisory support, identifying suitable partners, and fostering collaborative efforts. Additionally, they assist with business succession planning and provide online platforms for M&A matching. Established in 2005, this firm maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
